startScreen.title: How You Dare
description: Welcome to the edge of comfort.

questions.question: Do your best 30-second interpretive dance of a piece of fried chicken.
Strike and hold a high-fashion pose until your next turn.
Try to lick your elbow while maintaining eye contact with the person to your left.
Do 5 pushups while yelling 'I AM THE CHAMPION' after each one.
Open your window and scream 'I FOUND A RARE POKEMON' at the top of your lungs.
Text your 5th most recent contact: 'I know what you did with the sandwich.'
Speak only in an operatic singing voice for the next 5 minutes.
Let the group post any photo from your gallery to your Instagram/WeChat story with no context.
Smell everyone's hands and rank them from 'Most Flowery' to 'Most Concerning'.
Look at the person to your right and tell them what fruit they would be, with an uncomfortably detailed explanation.
Gently whisper your favorite Disney movie title into someone's ear.
Staring contest with the nearest inanimate object. If you blink, you must apologize to it.
Swap a piece of clothing with someone else in the group for the rest of the game.
Everyone take a sip of water, and you have to make them bark or laugh until they spit it out.
Find the weirdest thing in this room and try to sell it to the group like a desperate infomercial host.
